title: Titan's Mysterious Lakes

scenes.text: NASA's Cassini finds 20 lakes on Titan
Most people think Titan's lakes are filled with water
scenes.label: Water Lakes

scenes.text: Actually, Titan's lakes are filled with liquid methane and ethane
scenes.label: Methane Lakes

scenes.text: This discovery has major implications for our understanding of Titan's chemistry
scenes.label: Lake Chemistry

scenes.text: Follow for the science they never taught you.

description: NASA's Cassini has discovered lakes on Titan filled with liquid methane and ethane. This changes our understanding of Titan's chemistry. Follow for daily science!
